label: The reflection coefficient
subgoals: Subtract Z0 from the load impedance
Divide by the sum of the load impedance and Z0
Read the sign as a positive or inverted reflection

label: The voltage at the load
subgoals: Compute the launched voltage from the source divider with Z0
Multiply the launched voltage by one plus gamma

label: Return loss and VSWR
subgoals: Take the magnitude of the reflection coefficient
Compute VSWR from one plus and one minus that magnitude
Compute return loss as minus twenty log ten of the magnitude
